verdict.rationale: Puzzle's docs say users can export financial statements on a cash or accrual basis in Excel, CSV, and PDF, and get real-time financial reports with one click. Bank reconciliation is positioned as the way to ensure the reports are accurate. However, the evidence never names the three specific statements or shows arbitrary period selection. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement as distinct reports, documented custom/any-period date ranges, and independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.
